key_provisions_or_claims: Article 5(5) of Regulation 2019/947 now applies from 3 December 2023 instead of 2 December 2021.
Member States may accept operator declarations based on national standard scenarios until 2 December 2023.
Such declarations cease to be valid from 2 December 2025.
Delay is because harmonised standards for UAS classes C5 and C6 are not yet available.
Certain UAS.OPEN.060 and UAS.SPEC.050 points apply from 1 July 2022.
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1166 amends the EU drone operations Regulation 2019/947, postponing to 3 December 2023 the application of standard scenarios for UAS operations in or beyond visual line of sight, because harmonised standards for C5 and C6 class UAS are delayed. Transitional national scenarios are allowed.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1166 of 15 July 2021 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 as regards postponing the date of application for standard scenarios for operations executed in or beyond the visual line of sight
